'''October 2001 Cary tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cary on 26 October 2001. [[Brad Reinhold]] won it. It is known from Philip Marschall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3331">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-04-e1-cary-10-26d3331/ e1-cary-10-26], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 4 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-04-e1-cary-10-26d3331/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Cary
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 7
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Reinhold]]
